categories.title: Single Surface Exercises
categories.blurb: Snare-drum and pad-based exercises for technique, reading, and rudimental development.

items.title: Tech Routine 1
items.description: Develop full stroke, down stroke, tap, and up stroke through simple kinesthetic exercises before tackling the rudiments.

items.title: Tech Routine 2
items.description: A brief survey of short rolls, paradiddles, and flams — a sample-platter intro to the rudiments built on simple rhythms.

items.title: RTSK
items.description: Rich Thompson Stone Killer — a paradiddle-based exercise for building speed, endurance, and hand-turnaround control.

items.title: Eighth Note Rests
items.description: Feel and read simple eighth-note syncopations — source material for comping, coordination, and limb-independence work.

categories.title: Drumset Exercises
categories.blurb: Coordination, independence, and groove studies for the full kit.

items.title: Three Basic Rock Beats
items.description: Three foundational eighth-note rock beats with the same hand pattern and three different bass-drum placements — a beginner's first grooves.

items.title: Bass Drum Eighth Note Partials
items.description: Shift the bass drum across every eighth-note partial against a static hand pattern — coordination and ear training in one.

items.title: Bass Drum Sixteenth Note Partials
items.description: Develop bass-drum control and independence by placing sixteenth-note partials under a constant hand pattern.

items.title: Independence Exercise Pamphlet
items.description: Odd-meter coordination, cymbal-beat modulations, and cross-rhythms across 5/4, 7/4, and 9/4 — a deep independence workout.

items.title: "Chorale" Preliminary Exercises
items.description: Seven 5/8 and 7/8 polymeter exercises that build a 35-eighth-note cycle — coordination and a framework for improvisation.

items.title: Jazz Comping Exercise
items.description: This worksheet is geared towards beginner jazz drummers, and is meant to serve as a series of prompts for improvisation. Each line demonstrates a concept you can experiment with in order to generate compelling comping ideas without being limited by a lack of sophisticated four-way coordination.

categories.title: Transcriptions
categories.blurb: Drum and comping transcriptions from records I love.

items.title: Daahoud
items.description: Max Roach's drum solo on "Daahoud" from the 1954 Clifford Brown & Max Roach album — a hard-bop masterclass in form and phrasing.

items.title: Tony Williams — Seven Steps Solos (Chronological)
items.description: Three Tony Williams solos on Miles Davis' "Seven Steps to Heaven" (April '63 → February '64) tracing his bebop-to-post-bop evolution.

items.title: Marcus Gilmore — Chorale Comping Sample
items.description: A short comping sample from Marcus Gilmore on Vijay Iyer's "Chorale" — a study in modern jazz drumset accompaniment.

items.title: Island In The Sun
items.description: Drum part transcription for Weezer's "Island in the Sun" — a clean, beginner-friendly modern rock groove study.

items.title: Undone (The Sweater Song)
items.description: Drum part transcription for Weezer's "Undone (The Sweater Song)" — a song-form study perfect for early kit players.

handwritten.blurb: A handful of older worksheets in my own handwriting. To be digitized eventually.
